description:
Cast Everybody Lives! by paying {1}{W}, preventing players from losing life this turn.
Cast Wheel of Misfortune by paying {2}{R}, choosing an arbitrarily large number.  Wheel of Misfortune will deal damage to the player(s) who chose the largest number, but their life total will not decrease due to Everybody Lives!. You will still gain life equal to the amount of damage dealt this way due to Wheel of Misfortune's lifelink given to it by Soulfire Grand Master.
